read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside a directory authorized for this session or a bound skill directory. Returns the file with 1-based line numbers.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized or bound skill directory

write_file.description: Write a UTF-8 text file inside a directory authorized for this session, creating or replacing it.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized directory

edit_file.description: Replace an exact text snippet in a file inside a directory authorized for this session. The old text must appear exactly once unless replaceAll is set.

parameters.path: Relative to this session's default directory, or absolute inside an authorized directory

run_shell.description: Run a shell command with this session's default directory. Output is streamed and truncated; a long-running command is stopped at the timeout.

parameters.cwd: Directory to run in; defaults to this session's authorized default directory

load_skill.description: Read the full SKILL.md of one of your bound skills, by name.

send_message.description: Send an in-app message to another employee. It starts their work and their answer arrives as a message.

send_mail.description: Send an in-app mail to another employee. It starts their work and their reply arrives as a mail. Set awaitReply=true when this task cannot be finished without the other employee's result: after doing everything else the current run is paused, and the reply continues it, so the final answer must not be written before the reply is read. Leave awaitReply=false for notices and independent mails; their answers only land in the mailbox.

parameters.subject: Mail subject
parameters.newSession: Start an independent session with no inherited directories
parameters.inReplyTo: Sent mail entry in the current session to branch from
parameters.awaitReply: Wait for this employee's reply and continue this task with it (default false)

delegate_task.description: Hand a task to another employee and let them own it. Their result comes back to you as a message in this conversation.

parameters.task: What to do, and what to return
